fields.name: phone
fields.label: WhatsApp Number
fields.description: Include country code, digits only, e.g. 558008002006

fields.name: message
fields.label: Pre-filled Message
fields.description: Text placed in the chat when it opens, e.g. Gostaria de contratar planos Fibra Gamer!

fields.name: label
fields.label: Accessible Label
fields.description: Read by screen readers, e.g. Fale conosco pelo WhatsApp

fields.name: hoverLabel
fields.label: Hover Text
fields.description: Shown next to the icon on hover. Press Enter for a line break, e.g. Compre direto / pelo WhatsApp
